9f51518654363fad40fcda99a1eb2a8d.overview: In 1910s Paris, a sewer worker disillusioned with Christianity feels his prayers have been answered when he chances upon a street waif and they fall in love.

9f9360bb470039bcacfe79c4e429d787.overview: A police detective falls in love with the woman whose murder he's investigating.
9f9360bb470039bcacfe79c4e429d787.tagline: The story of a love that became the most fearful thing that ever happened to a woman!

9f97a5ce5dafeadd2f4d3d0d06065162.overview: The most popular film by Robert Downey Sr. is this offbeat classic about the antics that ensue after Putney Swope (Arnold Johnson, his voice dubbed by a gravelly Downey), the token black man on the board of a Madison Avenue advertising agency, is inadvertently elected chairman. Putney summarily fires the whiteys, replaces them with Black Power apostles, renames the company Truth and Soul, Inc., and proceeds to wreak politically incorrect havoc.

9fb25d8596bb969ac421ce3187383797.overview: Over the course of five social occasions, a committed bachelor must consider the notion that he may have discovered love.
9fb25d8596bb969ac421ce3187383797.tagline: Five good reasons to stay single.

9fc501e78917076787c275a7f914249d.overview: This neorealist masterpiece by Vittorio De Sica follows an elderly pensioner as he strives to make ends meet during Italy’s postwar economic recovery. Alone except for his dog, Flike, Umberto struggles to maintain his dignity in a city where human kindness seems to have been swallowed up by the forces of modernization. His simple quest to satisfy his basic needs—food, shelter, companionship—makes for one of the most heartbreaking stories ever filmed, and an essential classic of world cinema.

9fe6c596f09c82464c2eadc94d2024eb.overview: A nineteenth-century New Hampshire farmer makes a pact with Satan for economic success, then enlists famed orator Daniel Webster to extract him from his contract.

9ff58811f1195700863aecffda9832f9.overview: A Jewish boy separated from his family in the early days of WWII poses as a German orphan and is taken into the heart of the Nazi world as a 'war hero' and eventually becomes a Hitler Youth.
